Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000969" [decision]: As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway, security audit)
- memory_id "1000625": As of 2025-09-03, the Cinder team observed that after the runtime upgrade, the auth gateway's cold start time tripled.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000578" [decision]: After INC-2025-017, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000575": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000571": INC-2025-017 affected the auth gateway, which rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000544" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-29, every auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000250": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000909" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000845": As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000841" [decision]: As of 2025-11-27, Diego Alvarez left the Cinder team and joined the Ember team.  (about: Diego, Cinder, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000754": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000733" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder, having transferred from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000729": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000665": As of 2025-09-23, the job scheduler lives with the Cinder team, having moved from the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000661": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000652": As of 2025-09-16, the authentication gateway is owned by Cinder, having been handed over by the Ember team.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000644" [decision]: On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000387" [decision]: As of 2025-05-14, Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000606" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000808" [constraint]: The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000217" [constraint]: The authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC per the change policy.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000316" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
Existing entity names: Cinder, auth gateway, security audit, INC-2025-017, ledger service, Atlas team, product catalog, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Ember team, Dune team, job scheduler, authentication gateway, Boreal team, notifier, indexer, webhook dispatcher, billing API
